comparison.objective: Hands-free pipette-tip replacement and re-docking; candidate adjusts and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Passive-sleeve ejection, compliant tip seating, and docking versus recessed hex-key use, collar tuning, counterhold, and locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: Dispose used tip, retain fresh tip, avoid all tip contact/drop/tip-over, and dock versus two safe dynamic stops with no drift. Tip record lacks seating-force and alignment thresholds.
comparison.reason: Different objective and contact mechanics; generic alignment and force control alone do not make them duplicates.
